_about: Lips under a moustache, read by eye off previews/<slug>_eye_grid_mouth2.png (centred on the sculpted slit's middle, 1 mm grid): points [x mm across, z mm up] of the painted slit (the dark line between the painted lips) and of the moustache's painted lower edge. scripts/repaint_face.py lipsm moves the painted lips onto the sculpted slit and keeps the moustache. upper: what goes between the sculpted slit and the moustache's painted edge - 'lip' (an upper lip, the default) or 'hair' (the sculpted moustache reaches the slit). rel: 'groove' - heights are over the sculpted slit at that x (read from the pixels with LIPS_DEBUG=1), not over the mouth point. lower: [painted, sculpted] height of the lower lip in mm (default 8, 8). inner_dark: true - the slit is sculpted as a gap; its inner faces get a dark material (face_rig.py).
